case: muzzone-viral: real client Muzzone (music instrument retail, Astana); boss request «Сделайте нас вирусными в TikTok.» Run artifacts: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-flystuff/ed90e34e-b470-5816-9bae-4695c8c48b9b/scratchpad/brain/stress_v1/muzzone-viral/ (all steps present; the log reports a slate of 8, 7 owner questions, and 7 ideas filmed in week 1 in 14.9 min). The run finished.
verdict: The run finished, but what it delivers can't be used as is. The strategy is good: an honest push-back against the word "viral", a measurable objective (coded WhatsApp chats from new first-instrument buyers, 8/20/35 against a week-0 baseline), realism math with ranges, and strict truth handling (the «Финальная распродажа» risk, the PX-770 25% price swing, the Casio service in Almaty). Two problems stop it from being shippable. (1) The creative slate is safe and catalogue-like for a "make us viral on TikTok" brief. 7 of 8 slate ideas sit at consideration, conversion or retention. Every video is faceless and almost silent. None of the 5 ideas the model itself labelled wildcards was picked, and the highest-prior idea is a delivery-policy card (ID19). Both reviewers scored it 6/10 before and after the revision. (2) Code shipped the pre-revision plan as the deliverables. The staff shoot card films ID05, which the revision cut from week 1, plus the old glissando ID06 and ID19. The owner card skips all 12 revised owner asks. Instead it sends the chat-export request that the revision withdrew over privacy, the 3 intake questions whose deadline «до 10.10 12:00» had passed before the run finished, the same questions again inside a second ask, and English developer strings cut off mid-word. A real boss would get contradictory instructions to staff and an owner message that can't be answered.
best_part: The intake and measurement design. The push_back says it plainly in Russian: «Гарантировать, что ролик «залетит» в TikTok, не может никто… Успех считаем не в просмотрах, а в обращениях в WhatsApp по коду из ролика». The intake turns "viral" into «+20 coded WhatsApp inquiries from new contacts about first instruments», with conservative/expected/stretch targets, a week-0 baseline re-fixed on 2026-11-01, and REALISM math with a 10× range. It spots that «Финальная распродажа» could mean a closure, which would invalidate the brief. It catches the PX-770 price moving 695 913 → 521 935 ₸ within a day (E26) and bans prices in evergreen videos. It refuses to repeat «100% оригинальный товар» or the incentivised-review delivery compensation. After review it sets «вирусный» to mean ≥100 000 views and adds tier-2 attribution (DMs and «цена?» comment handoffs). Of the creative, ID01 (blind three-ukulele listen) and ID03 (electric unplugged vs through the combo, one continuous take) are the right kind of idea for one weak phone: close real sound, a stake in frame 1, a true reveal.

verdict:
The run finished: intake, inputs, insights, 24 ideas, selection, campaign, two reviews, one revision and a second review. The strategy is sound and honest. The single message «Послушайте, прежде чем платить» fits the brief: hands-only sound demos, a guitar+amp starter basket over the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery line, a ukulele gift line and ear tests. The truth discipline is strong. But the files that staff and the owner would actually receive are the pre-revision versions.

- **Shoot card is stale.** It still has 15 shots in 2 rooms and says "~15 мин", built on the 2-unit clearance Hibilly amp. The veteran reviewer called exactly this fatal. The revision moved piano to week 2 and dropped the Hibilly, but only in prose.
- **Codes are stale.** The CTAs still say «BA28» although the revision switched to the word codes «ГИТАРА»/«ПИАНИНО»/«УКУЛЕЛЕ».
- **Owner card is stale.** It still asks for the WhatsApp chat export the revision banned. It asks the 3 intake questions twice, once on their own and once inside the "tap card". It includes raw English validator strings. The asks the revision added (which amp, the 15.12 verdict date, Instagram access) were deferred.
- **The slate is not diverse.** The "diverse" slate is 5 of 8 guitar ideas, 4 of them on the same AS-100BK + Hibilly pair at the same wall. The sale line, one of the four lines the plan says it will test, has 0 ideas.
- **No real customer evidence.** Every customer tension is a guess (E44, E50). The agent's own fetch plan (2GIS, YouTube comments, Kaspi, search suggestions) was written down but never run.

The fatal_after=0 and approve_after=2 on the board measure prose, not the files people would use. Score about 5/10. With the slate patched, ID14, ID23, ID19 and ID01 (recorded through a cable into the phone) could ship.
best_part:
ID14, «Если дарите инструмент тому, кто не играет»: a C chord on the ukulele played with one finger, which is true by construction on camera.
- It needs 2 shots, about 2.4 staff minutes.
- An unplugged ukulele records cleanly on a weak phone at 20 cm.
- The gift buyer gets a concrete DM line, and the prices are from the ledger: U-246 22 100 ₸ and US-C40 32 901 ₸, both with a case («Чехол в комплекте: Да»).

Both reviewers singled it out. Around it, the run's truth discipline was real:
- It refused «Финальная» and any sale reason until the owner answers.
- It refused to promote the site's «компенсация доставки за честный отзыв» clause and «100% оригинальный товар».
- It used piano prices only from the 2026-10-09 ids.
- It turned every unverified claim (cable included, staff can play, «сыграем обе») into a NEEDS FACT instead of guessing.

The critique step was also good: it caught almost every real problem, including the 2-unit Hibilly dependency, the privacy risk of the chat export, the clipping risk of overdrive on a phone mic, and the slate/campaign drift.

case: dental: a hypothetical Almaty implant clinic with an empty facts ledger. Boss request: «Нужно больше пациентов на импланты.» The run finished: intake → inputs → insights (one source-fix) → 24 ideas (one rails-fix) → code slate of 8 → campaign → boss and veteran attack → one revision → re-review. dental.log: "questions for the owner: 15", "slate: ['ID05','ID20','ID14','ID04','ID21','ID02','ID03','ID11']; week 1 filmed ['ID05','ID20','ID14','ID04','ID02','ID03'] in 16.1 min". Code version at run time: 472b542. The owner-card fix 63c890a landed after this run.
verdict:
The revised strategy is close to what a good strategist would recommend. It contacts the clinic's own patients (people given an implant plan who never started), measured as a separate arm with the reply keyword «ВРАЧ». The surgeon becomes the hero («Вопрос хирургу»), price is answered without figures, and there are compliance gates. Truth discipline is strong: no numbers, no «без боли», and no «Нам пишут» without ≥2 real messages (C6.5 followed). The intake push_back is honest and in Russian.

The deliverables people would actually act on contradict that strategy and are unsafe.
- **Staff shoot card:** written by code from the slate chosen before the review. Its shots 1–2 are sterilisation footage marked «⭐ САМОЕ ВАЖНОЕ». It includes the patient testimonial (ID20) that the revision removed for legal risk, and surgeon answers whose medical facts are not yet confirmed. It is worded for a music shop («соцсети магазина», «комбик или барабаны»).
- **Owner card:** 15 items. Capacity, faces and prices are each asked twice. Some items are English labels, it includes staff tasks and items marked "deferred", and the facts line is cut off mid-word. Meanwhile all 10 revised Russian owner asks, including permission for the main lever, were deferred.
- **Selection:** code dropped the existing price idea (ID06), which sits on the bottleneck the agent itself had hypothesised, in favour of a coffee-bean wildcard and a reply video that cannot exist in week 1.
- **Evidence:** none was gathered. All 36 evidence items are assumptions or cross-vertical KB learnings, and all 10 insights are strength 2.
- **Where the main lever came from:** a simulated boss who invented «сотни» patients in the patient-records system (MIS). Its default is «да, первая волна 16.10», which breaks L8.
- **Offer:** a remote review of the patient's X-ray in WhatsApp, which is close to a teleconsultation.
- **Success metric:** undefined. It is named as coded bookings, but the target is a multiple of total bookings, and it now includes returning patients even though the intake said "new patients".

Not usable without fixes. Most root causes are code (stale card and slate, owner card, no fetch step, NEEDS FACT never gating selection) and method (F13 personas, A6 warm-base trigger, F4 offers for medical clinics, A4 metric definition).
best_part: ID05 «Когда хирург сам отговаривает от импланта». It is an honest_signal anti-sell aimed at the real fear of private clinics («насчитают на миллион»), and both reviewers picked it as best in both rounds. It is hands plus close voice, so it is producible, it is specific to implants, and it has a natural share line («вот, не все разводят»). Second best is ID14, the adult child deciding for a parent («POV: мама говорит „мне уже не надо“»), which gives a real family-chat share route. At plan level, the revision's three-way reporting (base arm «ВРАЧ» / content-coded floor / total vs a 4-week MIS baseline) is the right measurement idea. The empty-ledger truth discipline also held across all 24 ideas: zero invented numbers, prices, brands or outcome words.

verdict:
The run finished every step (intake, inputs, insights, 24 ideas, selection, campaign, two reviews, one revision, and a re-review). It is still not executable, because the documents that actually reach people contradict the plan. Both reviewers rejected v1 at 5/10, and the model then wrote a much better v2. v2 shows the address and landmark openly, uses a one-word «ЛЕВЫЙ» reminder, adds a window poster on the new site, a 2GIS card, a counter card at location 1, a preview evening for regulars and a geo-boost, and drops ID06 and ID19. Code never carried v2 into the outputs. The staff card (shoot_card_week1_ru.txt) is still the pre-revision plan: 8 of its 11 shots are for content v2 dropped or rewrote, including the line «Честно: в первый день не приходите», which the boss called fatal. The owner message is 4/7 English or English-laced and asks the superseded v1 questions. Its default «точные детали отправляем лично тем, кто напишет код» locks in the address-gate both reviewers rejected. The v2 truth-gate ask (address, landmark, permission to film the new site), the boost budget and the named reply person are all in questions_deferred.json. campaign.md is the owner-facing summary, and it is in English. It prints the v1 metric (40/80/150) and the v1 hooks next to the v2 strategy (60/120/250).

On substance, only one slate idea is strong for this objective: ID13, the POV about the other bank. ID03 (as re-specced in v2) and ID18 are conditional: ID03 only works if the landmark can be named, and ID18 only if the owner sends archive photos. ID06 works against what the boss asked for. ID17, ID18, ID19 and ID24 depend on inputs that cannot exist in week 1. The week-1 session needs both sites, across the river, although the stated constraint is one session at one site. Weeks 2–3, the conversion window, carry only 2 posts each. Truth discipline was good: nothing invented reached audience copy, and every gap was flagged as NEEDS FACT. The selection code ignored those flags, though. Both re-reviews 'approved' at a score of 6, which breaks F13's rule that approval needs ≥7.
best_part: The revised channel layer in campaign.json. A window poster on the covered shopfront (QR plus its own code) reaches people who walk past every day. The new location's 2GIS card goes live before opening. A counter card at location 1 and a preview evening reach the warm base. The geo-boost is decided at onboarding, not at D−11. A «ЛЕВЫЙ» POS button gives attribution at the till. Together this admits that a ~2.1k Reels account cannot reach Левый берег on its own (REALISM ratio ≈1–33) and supplies the local levers that actually work. Truth gating was also good: no date, address, offer, menu item or number was invented anywhere, and every gap became a NEEDS FACT. The re-reviews were sharp and concrete (stale slate cards, «левый» = shady in slang, Instagram DM reminder delivery, two sites in one session).

failures.fix: F5: every CTA promise names its delivery mechanism, the responsible person and a volume cap. failures.fix: Rule (code): card tips are generated from the D9 generic phone rules plus a per-vertical tips file selected by profile.vertical, and the header uses profile.name. checks.py H4 warning («no number or model/brand token: is it specific?») fires on 23/24 hooks for an empty-ledger client. It is pure noise and hides real warnings.

Question deadlines are absolute strings written at intake time («Ответ до 10.10 12:00»), and the owner card was emitted at 10.10 15:29 with the deadlines already past. Nothing recomputes them at render time.

Нам вообще нужны соцсети?» The run finished: intake, inputs, insights, 24 ideas, an 8-idea slate, campaign, reviews, one revision, re-review, owner card and week-1 shoot card. best_part:
The honest framing with a verdict fixed in advance. failures.what: The test is organic-only, a design that answers 'can a brand-new one-city account get leads in 4 weeks?', not 'does this B2B firm need social?'. The strongest lever, the reps, is defaulted off, and 2GIS is demoted to a 'control'.

verdict:
The run finished. Every artefact exists: intake, inputs, insights, 24 ideas, selection, campaign revision 2, reviews before and after, the questions files, campaign.md and shoot_card_week1_ru.txt. The diagnosis and conversion layer are good. The run diagnoses before it films (intake Q1 «Кто именно уходит? … 3 — клиенты ушли вслед за мастером»). It adds DR0 (fix slow replies or master churn before content), a quick reply that sends the price with a next step («Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день вам удобнее?»), a no-discount reactivation arm and the MASTER1 master-flight guard. Both personas named this layer the best part.

The video side does not answer the boss's question. None of the 8 slate ideas shows why the price is worth paying. The four price/backstage ideas in the pool (ID03, ID04, ID05, ID06) lost to a POV, an ASMR loop and an anti-sell («Честно: иногда салон вам не нужен», which ranked #2). 7 of the 8 are about nails. The evidence base is 100% assumption because nothing was fetched.

The revision then made week 1 depend on two «NEXT BATCH» hero episodes that do not exist. One of them is a re-invention of ID05, which the campaign step never saw. As a result the boss persona went from 6/10 and approve to 5/10 and reject, with a new fatal: «Главных роликов в плане нет».

What the code would actually send is worse than the plan:
- **Shoot card:** it films 7 pre-revision ideas, including the unapproved ID19 and the blocked ID13. The steps are in an impossible order («6. Ноготь после снятия» before «9. снятие гель-лака»). The tips come from the music-store template («комбик или барабаны»).
- **Owner message:** 13 items, 9 of them English internal labels. It asks the owner to confirm a regex hit. Every campaign ask the plan depends on is left out (reactivation approval, hygiene tick-list, quick-reply approval, master names).

As delivered, it is not usable.
best_part: Week 0 diagnoses before anything is filmed, with a non-content fix first. Intake Q1 separates the three ways clients leave: «новые: узнают цену и не записываются / постоянные перестали возвращаться / ушли вслед за мастером». DR0 says «if the export shows a median first reply over 60 min … or that most lost clients left with a departed master, fixing replies or staffing comes first». The after-price quick reply «[цена из прайса]. Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день вам удобнее?» needs no staff minutes and goes at the exact leak the boss describes. MASTER1 (booking only through the salon number, and master names only with the owner's «да») shows real salon know-how. Both reviewers, before and after the revision, picked this layer as the best idea.

The step 6, revision and review prompts receive only the 8 slate ideas, not the validated pool. The revision re-invented ID05 («Что происходит до того, как вы сели») as «NEXT BATCH E1».

select() has no coverage constraint for insight, bottleneck engine or service line. `blocked` covers only ideas with errors, not NEEDS FACT items that block shooting («Owner approval required before shooting»).

owner_card/owner_message render `q` = the inputs' English `input` label instead of the Russian `how`. Facts items are raw English rail messages. Dedupe is a 120-character text prefix, so «who leaves» is asked twice. Campaign owner_asks come last and are always starved (in HEAD, slots = 7−3−1 = 3 are used up by the inputs asks). At run time (472b542) staff asks were also on the owner card, at 0 minutes each.
brain.py:610 make_code(1, n+1) is constant, so every run and client gets BA23…BA32. loop.record_leads overwrites code→idea across runs.

shootcard.order_by_location sorts by shot kind across ideas («Ноготь после снятия» comes before «снятие гель-лака»). The minute model counts only footage seconds, not the process states the shots need.
shootcard.TIPS_RU and the header are hard-coded for the music store: «соцсети магазина», «комбик или барабаны», «30–50 см», and iPhone-only «Пункт управления».
checks.SCARCITY matches «последний день» in a question or advice (ID15, ID20). These become owner questions.

There is no step-2 executor for `who: agent` inputs; acquire.fill_facts handles only e-commerce product pages. stress.py adds --no-fetch for hypothetical clients, so the evidence base is 100% assumption.
Staff minutes are checked only for filming shots. worker_ask_ru items (KZ check, reactivation ≈10 min/day, labels, reality scan) are never summed against the 17-minute plan.
render_md reads nonexistent keys (driver_mechanism, engine), prints only pre-revision review scores, and mixes the pre-revision filmed list with the post-revision weeks.
Reviewers get neither METHOD nor the idea pool, so the creator's fatal could not be answered with an existing idea (ID05/ID04).
